sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r1/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 17 (#16 environment_does_not_leak_the_answer) and Internal Quality Checks row 17 (no extra annotation beyond the description)
task/tests/.dockerignore, tests/Dockerfile (COPY lines), tests/scored/*/judge.toml and prompt.md, tests/gates/*/judge.toml and prompt.md, tests/app_context.md (n-gram overlap scan)
evidence: Skill quality-checks.md:70-71 asks: /app holds only .gitkeep; no starter, skeleton, schema, route list or partial UI in the agent image; nothing under /instructions reproduces criterion text or the rubric. (1) environment/Dockerfile: build context is environment/ only; the only COPY lines are 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; /app is created with 'mkdir -p /app', 'git -C /app init', 'touch /app/.gitkeep', 'git -C /app add .gitkeep', commit 'Initialize task workspace'. No COPY of solution/ or tests/, no npm package of the golden, no prebuilt docker_image in task.toml ([environment] has only build_timeout_sec/network_mode/cpus/memory_mb). Global installs are only express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (runtime deps the brief names). Verifier runs environment_mode="separate" (task.toml:28), so tests/ never enters the agent image. (2) environment/ contains exactly Dockerfile, assets/kittle.json, instructions/{conversations,integration,walls-and-retention}.md. assets/kittle.json (sha256 42ab8b97...646fc2) is byte-identical to solution/app/seed/kittle.json; that is the seed input the brief points to (instruction.md:5), not a deliverable. It contains only raw inputs (accounts, matters, messages with timestamps/hold flags/versions, walled list, read_up_to); it does NOT precompute derived answers such as which messages have expired (e.g. K-1 at 2026-05-01 on a 7-day matter is left in the seed for the app to delete), ordering, unread counts or transcript output. (3) Notes contain no schema, table list, API route list or UI skeleton; the only route named is 'GET /api/health' (integration.md:3), which is the shared runtime contract, plus port/DB_PATH/NODE_PATH/fixed clock. (4) Rubric leakage scan: scripted token n-gram comparison of instruction.md + all /instructions notes against every tests/**/*.md and *.toml: zero shared 10-grams; at 6-grams only short public-requirement phrases quoted BY criteria from the notes ('shows a short preview of the linked message' 8 tokens, 'typing the words on hold into a message' 8, 'sit under the message they answer' 6) and the accounts table echoed in app_context.md. No criterion ids, step lists, weights, Part A/B structure or judge vocabulary appear in the notes. Broken-app probe: a weak agent cannot pass by copying anything from /app, /assets or /instructions, since nothing there is executable app code or a rendered expected output; it must build server.js and UI from scratch. Conforming-alternative probe: nothing in the environment constrains architecture beyond the public runtime contract, so a differently structured correct app is not disadvantaged. Limitation: I did not build the agent image (static Dockerfile review is sufficient for this row since the build context and COPY set are closed); raw-evidence-index has no agent-image inspection entry, but this row does not need runtime measurement.
